mapper.select: SELECT id,taste_name,create_open_id,create_time,status,nickname,total_score,average,img_url from ( SELECT vt.id, vt.taste_name, vt.create_open_id, vt.create_time, vt.status, vt.img_url, vtu.nickname, sum(score) as total_score, avg(score) as average FROM vote_taste vt LEFT JOIN vote_taste_user vtu ON vt.create_open_id = vtu.openid LEFT JOIN vote_taste_score vts ON vt.create_open_id = vts.open_id group by vt.id ) t ORDER BY create_time asc LIMIT #{pageIndex}, #{pageSize}

SELECT count(0) from ( SELECT vt.*, vtu.nickname, sum(score) as total_score, avg(score) as average FROM vote_taste vt LEFT JOIN vote_taste_user vtu ON vt.create_open_id = vtu.openid LEFT JOIN vote_taste_score vts ON vt.create_open_id = vts.open_id group by vt.id ) t
